chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Samāʿah ibn Mihrān, who said:
I asked him about two women who are found in a single coverlet. He said: “Each one of them is to be given one hundred lashes.”

key_terms.تُجْلَدُ: is to be flogged or lashed
key_terms.ٱلْمَرْأَتَيْنِ: the two women being asked about in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām on two women found in one coverlet?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling concerning two women found together in one coverlet. It is presented in a juridical context within the chapter on the hadd concerning siḥāq, indicating its relevance to penal rulings in fiqh.
